text: Highly recommended. I had an acute problem. From the appointment scheduling, to the friendliness of the receptionist, the cleanliness of the practice, and the absolute professional execution of the procedure, I highly recommend this clinic. Dr. K. Nana was very empathetic, and thanks to her, I've never had such a painless and pleasant treatment. A huge thank you to everyone, especially Dr. K. Nana.
Calm&cozy dental clinic, nice and friendly staff!

I went there for cleaning and checkup on 18 May, 2024. The premises are clean, new, well-furnished. Maintenance is on a high level. The doctor is very friendly and helpful, the dental cabinet is spacious. Comfort is the priority. Treatment began exactly on time without any delays. I couldn't spot a single disadvantage. I will definitely recommend it to everyone.

First time visiting these guys and the care they take is outstanding. You know all the annoying things that happen at dentists, like when they dont suck all the water out properly, or when they lean on your lip with their tool and push it into your teeth or when you have a super sensitive gag reflex and they push on regardless. These guys went way out of their way to ensure my comfort. They even use numbing gel before the injection so you dont feel the needle. Service was quick, efficient, friendly and the cost was surprisingly reasonable. Highly recommended.

Had my tooth cleaning done here twice. First time with a female doctor was excellent and tartar removal carefully executed. 5 stars. Second time with a male doctor was the opposite: uncomfortable, hard treatment removing tartar left me with bloody gum and red abrasions on interdental spaces. Not careful at all. I had to tell twice to pause the tratment. Apologetic though, however painfully careless since gum doesn't grow back. 1 star. Disappointed.

My cleaning and filling for a chipped tooth was completed quickly and with a gentle expert touch I think all dentists should have. I'm never comfortable in dentists, but all the friendly staff helped put me at ease. Excellent place!

Be Well Dental clinic is excellent!!   I recently had a root canal performed by Dr. Man and he was extremely professional and caring, as well as his staff. I had minimal discomfort from start to finish and no pain afterwards.  I had follow up at one month and was not charged for that appointment.  The cost was less than another dental place that I had visited and I believe I made the right decision to put my trust in Dr. Man at Be Well!!
